description: This Python source file provides functions for extracting text content from various file formats including TXT, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and JSON. It supports detailed parsing, data normalization, and summary generation for structured data, facilitating integration into data processing pipelines or APIs.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Main interface to extract readable text from a file, based on filename extension, supporting TXT, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and JSON formats.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decode bytes as UTF-8 and return as plain text.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text content from a PDF using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text from a DOCX file, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract structured context and text from an XLSX workbook, including headers, data rows, unique value analysis, JSON samples, and previews.

methods.name: str _extract_json(content: bytes)
methods.description: Parse JSON content, producing summaries for arrays (of objects or primitives) and objects, including structure, key types, samples, and nested data.

methods.name: str _json_array_of_objects_summary( arr: List[Any], title: str = "[JSON Array of objects]", json_sample_rows_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_SAMPLE_ROWS", tsv_preview_rows_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_TSV_PREVIEW_ROWS", unique_limit_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_UNIQUE_LIMIT", scan_rows_env: str = "FILE_EXTRACT_JSON_SCAN_ROWS", )
methods.description: Generate a summary for an array of JSON objects, including columns, unique values, samples, and TSV preview.

methods.name: List[str] _flatten_keys(d: Dict[str, Any], parent: str = "", sep: str = ".", depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = 2)
methods.description: Collect flattened keys from nested dictionary up to specified depth, used for JSON structure analysis.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _flatten_to_record(obj: Dict[str, Any], max_depth: int = 2, max_str_len: int = 300)
methods.description: Flatten a nested JSON object into a single-level dict with dot notation keys, suitable for tabular representation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_record(headers: List[str], row_vals: List[Any])
methods.description: Convert a list of row values into a dict mapped to column headers, coercing values for JSON friendliness.

methods.name: str _record_to_tsv(headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Convert a record dict into a TSV line with proper escaping.

methods.name: None _update_uniques(uniques: Dict[str, set], headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any], limit: int)
methods.description: Update per-column set of unique string values for listing and analysis, limited to a configurable count.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Produce a compact, single-line preview of large extracted text for user confirmation.
